en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,
‘Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic as firends with the Sultan (ruling authority) by whom He<sup>azwj</sup> Defends His<sup>azwj</sup> friends’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of our people from Ali ibn Yaqtin who has said the following:
“Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has friends with the Sultan through whom He protects His friends.’”
